Gear up for an extraordinary journey with SBC Summit, taking place on 19 September – 1 October in the city of Lisbon.

Imagine 450+ speakers dropping wisdom in a variety of dynamic conference formats, an electric exhibition floor spanning a whopping 100,000m2, and an opportunity to connect with 25,000 industry professionals.

When you step onto the expo floor, get ready to mingle with 600 exhibitors showcasing the newest industry goodies. There is a simplified navigation through this grand space, breaking it down into themed areas like the Casino & iGaming Zone, Sports Betting Zone, Player Protection Zone, Esports Zone and two summits: Payment Expert Summit and Affiliate Leaders Summit. Oh, and don’t overlook the Food & Hospitality and the Media Headquarters.

Join the summit that transcends the boundaries of mere business.
